messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
To: Dr. Amira Khan <amira@dataspark.ai>, Nate Hill <nate@dataspark.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Webinar speaker timezone heatmap + recording ownership and consent

Hi Amira —

Thanks again for agreeing to join the Redwood inference live webinar on June 15. Two quick coordination items I want to lock down now so ops can finalize the run:

1) Recording preference and ownership: do you prefer we capture a single live take (we provide a polished MP4 after a light edit), or would you rather record locally and upload your own master? We need your sign-off for distribution/republishing and a signed consent before the event.

2) Timezone heatmap: your availability note said mornings PT; because we have EMEA attendees we may shift the start by 30 minutes. I attached a draft schedule (2027-05-25-draft-schedule.xlsx) — please flag any conflicts.

Ops team (Karthik/Soojin/Mateo) — can you confirm who will own the recording (Redwood S3 ingest vs. guest upload), captioning, and the backup OBS recording plan? I want named owners so we can add them to the run-of-show.

Attachments: 2027-05-25-draft-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Dr. Amira Khan <amira@dataspark.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Cc: Nate Hill <nate@dataspark.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Webinar speaker timezone heatmap + recording ownership and consent

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the details. Quick answers: I prefer Redwood capture a single live take and provide the edited MP4. That reduces friction for my team. I'm happy to sign a standard speaker consent that allows Redwood to host and distribute the recording for marketing purposes.

Availability: mornings PT work best (8:30–11:00 PT). The attached draft looks fine except the 10:15 PT slot on June 15 — I have a standing internal sync then. Can we move me to 10:40 PT if possible?

Also: Nate (my producer) copied here — he handles the technical side on our end. If you need a local backup, he can provide a local recording file within 24 hours post-event.

Best,
Amira
Dr. Amira Khan
Head of Applied ML, Dataspark AI
amira@dataspark.ai

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar speaker timezone heatmap + recording ownership and consent

Lauren / Amira —

Great — thanks Amira, single take + Redwood edit works fine. Action items and proposed owners below: 

- Recording capture (live): Redwood studio + OBS local backup — owner: Mateo Alvarez
- Post-event encrypted ingest to S3 and edit pass: Redwood Editing Team (S3 path will be provided by Mateo)
- Captions (live & post): Soojin Lee (live captions during stream; 24-hour post-event VTT)
- Speaker consent & DocuSign: Lauren to send consent; legal to countersign
- Slide ingest & naming: request speaker upload to Drive by Jun 8; naming convention: DATASPARK_Amira_SLIDES_v1.pdf — see presenter-upload-spec.pdf

I'll also shift the slot to 10:40 PT on the draft schedule and run it by stage manager. Mateo — can you confirm OBS recording retention (how long we keep mediatakes) and S3 folder name?

Attachments: presenter-upload-spec.pdf (PDF)

Karthik
Sr. Events Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>, Dr. Amira Khan <amira@dataspark.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar speaker timezone heatmap + recording ownership and consent

All —

Confirming ownership and fallback plan:

- I'll run the OBS local recording on stage laptop and push a copy to S3 within 2 hours of the session (S3 path: s3://redwood-webinars/dataspark/2027-06-15/).
- Retention: keep raw OBS recording for 30 days, edited MP4 indefinitely (marketing bucket policy).
- If Nate provides a local master, please ask him to upload to the Drive folder (link to follow) and name it DATASPARK_Amira_MASTER_DATE.mp4. We'll compare and use the cleaner master for final edit.
- Phone backup: Amira / Nate, could you share the number we can call to capture a phone audio backup if needed?

I've attached an OBS checklist I use on the day — basic steps and file naming.

Attachments: obs-recording-checklist.txt (text)

Thanks —
Mateo
Production Lead, Events
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference

Amira / Nate —

Perfect — thank you both. Final checklist I will action tonight: 

- Send DocuSign speaker consent (Lauren) — link: https://app.docusign.com/consent/ABC-123-DATASPARK
- Update run-of-show with 10:40 PT slot and add named owners (Karthik)
- Drive folder + slide upload deadline Jun 8 (naming per spec) — presenter upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_presentation_upload
- Mateo to confirm S3 upload path and retention (confirmed above)
- Soojin to enable live captions and post VTT within 24 hours

Amira — can you please confirm the phone number for an audio backup and that Nate will upload any local masters within 24 hours if he records? Once I have your consent signed we'll finalize the promotional copy.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — will add these as action items and follow up on June 9 for final pre-call.

Best,
Lauren
